target_db: Pfam-A.fasta (63,811,783 seed sequences, full canonical Pfam-A seed alignment set)
note: primary_metric counts queries with at least one hit AND best e > 1e-3; aug_metric counts no-hit OR best e > 1e-3 (canonical novelty definition). With 0 hits in both arms at default -e 1e-3 against full Pfam-A, both arms saturate at 0 hits.
